ja: 「SDガンダム武者番長風雲録」に第四の番長「青狼頑駄無」登場。パーツの差し替えにより武者形態から小動物形態、獣人形態、大型獣前半身（後半身）に組み換え可能。頭部には眼帯スコープを装着可能。付属する２本のバズーカは両肩に装備可能、また２本を繋げたロングバズーカを再現可能します。
en: The fourth Bancho "Blue Wolf Gundam" appears in "SD Gundam Musha Bancho Fuunroku". By replacing parts, it can be recombined from warrior form to small animal form, beastman form, and large beast first half (second half). An eyepatch scope can be attached to the head. The two bazookas included can be equipped on both shoulders, and a long bazooka can be recreated by connecting the two bazookas.
